::: {#def-pip}
#### Posterior inclusion probability

When the candidate models $M_1, \ldots, M_K$ of @def-bma differ in which [predictors](model-validation.qmd#def-covariate) they include,
the **posterior inclusion probability** of a predictor $\predvar_j$
is the [sum](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mds/algebra-sums.html#def-summation) of the [posterior model probabilities](#def-posterior-model-probability)
of the models that include it:

$$
\text{PIP}_j \eqdef \sum_{k:\, \predvar_j \in M_k} \p(M_k \mid \vy).
$$
:::
